# Lumiphane 3D

> Browser-based lithophane generator for FDM 3D printing. Upload a photo, preview it with a simulated backlight, then export an STL, standard 3MF, or Bambu Studio project. Photos stay on your device — Lumiphane does not store them on a server. No account required.

Lumiphane (https://lumiphane.com/) turns JPEG, PNG, or WebP photos into 3D lithophanes: thin white-PLA walls that look pale in room light and show the picture when lit from behind. Geometry is built in the browser with an interactive WebGL preview and a backlight simulation tuned for white PLA.

Shapes: flat panel, curved panel, round cylinder, hollow cube, and hexagon. Each shape holds 1–4 photos (hexagon up to 6). Optional border motifs (heart, star, bone) and bed footing. Thickness follows part size (about 0.8–3.0 mm for panels ≤120 mm); contrast, brightness, and invert control the image.

The app builds the model only. You slice and print in your own software. Optional handoffs: email an export, tip via Stripe, or order a physical print through Treatstock. No accounts.

## Start here

- [Lithophane generator](https://lumiphane.com/): Upload photos, select a shape, preview with simulated backlight, and export STL, 3MF, or Bambu Studio project files
- [How to make a lithophane](https://lumiphane.com/how-to-make-a-lithophane/): Complete beginner guide from image selection to physical 3D print
- [Photo to lithophane](https://lumiphane.com/photo-to-lithophane/): Image preparation, cropping, contrast balance, and multi-photo collage layouts
- [Lithophane lamp](https://lumiphane.com/lithophane-lamp/): Cylinders, hexagonal lanterns, cubes, and curved shades with LED thermal guidelines
- [3D printed lithophane](https://lumiphane.com/3d-printed-lithophane/): Upright print orientation, white PLA optical properties, layer heights, and slicer settings
- [Bambu Studio lithophane](https://lumiphane.com/bambu-studio-lithophane/): Export pre-configured Bambu Studio 3MF project files with 0.12 mm layers and 100% infill
- [Lithophane settings](https://lumiphane.com/lithophane-settings/): Technical breakdown of wall thickness, exposure adjustments, and slicer parameters
